annotations.title: Convert a clothing or shoe size

description: Convert a size label between sizing systems (UK, US, EU/FR, AU, IT, JP, chest/waist/collar in inches or cm) for women's clothing, women's jeans, men's suits and jackets, men's shirts, men's trousers, women's shoes, men's shoes and children's clothing. Returns the equivalent labels in every system for that size, the table it came from and a source link. Leave `to` empty to get all systems.

from.description: Sizing system of the size you have, e.g. "uk", "us", "eu", "ukus" (inches), "cm", "w" (jeans waist), "age".

size.description: The size label to convert, e.g. "12", "40", "15.5", "28".

name: convert_clothing_size
title: Convert a clothing or shoe size
